children: Tesla and SpaceX formed special committees to explore a possible merger, but stressed no deal is assured. Any transaction would require committee, board and shareholder approval.
Tesla began building its $10 billion Crystal Sun solar factory near Houston. The site is expected to be complete in 2028, with production targeted for Q1 2029 and over 9,000 jobs planned.
Tesla plans to add an Austin factory shift to boost Cybertruck output and address its backlog, then dismantle the line around mid-next year and repurpose capacity for Cybercab production.
Tesla (TSLA) launched its robotaxi service in San Antonio at 5 a.m. local time on Nov. 9. It has not disclosed operating hours, coverage, fleet size or whether safety monitors ride along.
Tesla Cybertruck sales fell 28% year over year to an estimated 11,600 through September, far below Elon Musk’s 250,000 annual target. SpaceX bought $131 million of Cybertrucks last year.
Tesla (TSLA) is working with SpaceX on the Terafab chip project in Texas. Analyst Dan Ives sees Tesla shifting toward autonomy, Cybercabs and robotics, with a bumpy transition ahead.
Tesla had 1,302 registered Robotaxis in Texas, more than Waymo’s state fleet. It also reported 681 unsupervised vehicles across Texas and parts of Florida: 411 Model Ys and 270 Cybercabs.
Tesla (TSLA) won Finnish approval to offer its driver-assistance system, after the country recognized provisional Dutch type approval. Sales can start immediately; an EU-wide decision is pending.
A South Korean advocacy group accused Tesla of misleading buyers by promoting driver-assistance software that most local Tesla vehicles cannot legally use. Tesla did not comment.
Jefferies lowered its price target for Tesla, Inc. (TSLA) from $400 to $375.
